scripts.test:e2e: mkdir -p .supabase-cli-config && eval "$(DO_NOT_TRACK=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.supabase-cli-config supabase status -o env)" && DB_URL="$DB_URL" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="$API_URL" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$ANON_KEY" SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="$SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.playwright-browsers playwright test
scripts.db:reset: mkdir -p .supabase-cli-config && DO_NOT_TRACK=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.supabase-cli-config supabase db reset
scripts.db:test: mkdir -p .supabase-cli-config && DO_NOT_TRACK=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.supabase-cli-config supabase test db
scripts.db:types: mkdir -p .supabase-cli-config && DO_NOT_TRACK=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.supabase-cli-config supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > src/platform/database/database.types.ts.tmp && sed -e '${/^$/d;}' src/platform/database/database.types.ts.tmp > src/platform/database/database.types.ts && rm -f src/platform/database/database.types.ts.tmp
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build
